title: Seeing is not Enough: Vision-Language Models Perceive Evidence but Fail to Act
abstract: arXiv:2609.22588v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform strongly on visual question answering benchmarks, yet often make decisions that contradict visual evidence they have already identified correctly. We distinguish perceptual failure, where relevant evidence is not recognized, from process failure, where recognized evidence fails to constrain the final decision. We introduce VPAC-Bench, a benchmark spanning nine real-image process families, with each image annotated by its current activity stage and nearby stage transition. We also propose State-Relevance-Target (SRT), a family of structured process-prior interventions that requires models to connect visible evidence to the relevant process state before answering. Across multiple VLMs, process failure is widespread: models that correctly enumerate visual candidates still over-commit to a single answer in more than 95% of ambiguous cases. translated_title: 仅仅看见是不够的：视觉语言模型能感知证据却无法据此行动
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉问答基准测试中表现优异，但其做出的决策常常与自身已经正确识别的视觉证据相矛盾。我们区分了两种失败类型：感知失败，即相关证据未被识别；以及过程失败，即已被识别的证据未能约束最终决策。我们提出了VPAC-Bench，这是一个涵盖九个真实图像过程族的基准，每张图像都标注了其当前活动阶段及邻近的阶段转换。我们还提出了状态-相关性-目标（State-Relevance-Target, SRT）方法，这是一类结构化的过程先验干预，要求模型在回答之前将可见证据与相关过程状态建立联系。在多个VLM上的实验表明，过程失败普遍存在：即使模型能够正确列举视觉候选，在超过95%的模糊案例中仍然过度承诺单一答案。显式的过程结构化干预能够降低这一比率……
tldr: 该论文揭示了视觉语言模型普遍存在的“过程失败”问题——即使正确识别了视觉证据也无法据此约束最终决策，并提出了VPAC-Bench基准与SRT结构化过程先验干预方法来诊断和缓解这一问题。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that vision-language models widely suffer from "process failure"—failing to constrain final decisions despite correctly perceiving visual evidence—and introduces VPAC-Bench along with the State-Relevance-Target (SRT) structured process-prior intervention to diagnose and mitigate this issue.
